note: Second campaign, redesigned from the pilot's lessons. The CJH grid is the dense steady CSTR map over (T, tau) -- same reactor and closure as the transient cases, which the 512-point OpenMKM PFR sweep is not -- 25 C spacing refined to 5 C across the ignition cliff, 25 log-spaced tau columns. The design scan drops the drawn trapezoid for the element's own integrated T(t): four axes (voltage, period, duty, tau), all knobs a person can turn, with T_peak/T_min/ramp recorded as results. 192 cases = 128 train / 32 validation / 32 held out. The earlier 7-axis trapezoid shards are superseded; the closure diagnostic already ran and is off.
